content: vcpkg ffmpeg port is at version 9.0 (matching upstream FFmpeg 9.0 'Lei', Aug 2026). Features include avcodec, avformat, swscale, swresample, dav1d, zlib, gpl, nonfree, x264/x265, plus dozens more. No standalone 'vmaf' feature in the ffmpeg port itself; libvmaf is a separate vcpkg port (3.2.0) with no cuda feature exposed.
